finding: STAR 2602 supports solution interpolation on remeshing or mesh replacement. Higher-order stencil is recommended for transient analysis. Conservative correction is available only for supported model combinations.
limitation: Our workflow rebuilds/imports an exact one-cell-span CGNS region. Automatic interpolation is not yet established for that replacement. VOF and SST compatibility and conservation correction must be checked in the actual continuum; do not assume support.
experiment: On a new attempt copied from an accepted checkpoint, retain region identity and replace the mesh using supported mesh-replacement/mapping. Verify phase bounds and total water volume, finite pressure/velocity/turbulence, surface continuity and force transients. Re-settle independently. A matched cold-start check is required before treating mapping as a validated time saver.
action: Do not change the running M08 or initialize M09 from a mapped field before this audit.
